status: Exported geometry and state-driven renderer; combined replay acceptance pending
coordinateSystem: Local metres; X/Z ground, Y up; original house origin retained.

data.surfaces: Array {id,kind,level,triangles,normal,thickness,material,bounds,sourceMeshBindings,supportSurfaceIds,fuelClass,fuelAmount,finish}; one canonical record per physical patch; kind:attachment is an exact nonplanar source solid with solidTriangles, thickness:0, material/fuelAmount, sourceMeshBindings, attachmentHostSurfaceIds, supportSurfaceIds and supportBinding. It is not a plane to extrude by its first normal. presentationKind hides roof trim in cutaway.
data.openings: Array {id,surfaceId,level,kind,bounds,polygon,pivot,closedTransform,openTransform,sourceMeshBindings}; source geometry and prototype adaptations distinguished
data.items: Array grouping actual furnitureParts by itemId; independent item transforms and support bindings; supportContacts are independent of render pivots; supportContacts polygon is an actual downward source facet intersected with real floor triangles, with sourcePartId/sourceBottomFace/contactY/gap.
data.stores: Array {id,itemId,kind,level,position,bounds,amount,amountUnit,supportSurfaceIds,fuelPartId}; fuel appears once in furnitureParts
data.render: Canonical source geometries, physical material appearances and per-fragment source/item bindings; no new donor import
data.navigation: Measured baseline bounds and explicit authorized adaptations; freeze after coder passage measurement

frame.boundaries: Array {id,sourceSurfaceId,triangles or polygon,intact,openFraction,charFraction,heatFraction}; additional patch coverage retires only its actual geometry
frame.supports: Same stable sourceSurfaceId/coverage convention as boundaries
frame.items: Array {id or itemId,position,quaternion,intact,remainingFraction,charFraction}; matrix accepted as an alternative pose
frame.falls: Retained stable-ID upserts. Camera-only/paused draws may supply empty arrays at the same revision; these do not clear live flights. Every collection:falls tombstone removes airborne state unconditionally, regardless of historical landing events. full replaces; optional completeCollections:[falls] explicitly reconciles a complete snapshot. Geometry uses exact clipped solids and origin.
frame.events: Array of authoritative window-break, spill, support-failure and landing records
frame.metrics: Authoritative accounting and budgets; presentation never derives gameplay
frame.fireSamples: Published structural-fire fields plus sourceSurfaceId or itemId; floorFootprint triangles or floorRadius bounds the visible horizontal envelope; authoritative zero-flame smoke is accepted (preheat:true). Normal ny:-1 and underside Y remain below the intact slab. Vent samples use vent:true and canonical openingId/sourceSurfaceId. Current fallId/rubbleId/supportBoundaryId and floorFootprint define physical ownership. originalSourceSurfaceId is provenance and may be retired; it cannot veto live landed or airborne effects.
frame.tombstones: Collection-scoped {collection,id} removals. A collection:rubble tombstone never deletes a same-ID current fall; a collection:falls tombstone retires only airborne state. Legacy untyped IDs use a matching retained collection only when collection is absent.
frame.occupancy: Optional debug records {id,bounds,heatFraction,occupied}; x-ray shows these actual simulation records when supplied
frame.parts: Array {id,itemId,intact,remainingFraction,charFraction,heatFraction}; delta records retained independently of parent poses. Inert parts remain after combustible contents are spent.
frame.rubble: Retained stable-ID upserts with current fuelIds, actual floorFootprint/supportBoundaryId and phase/amount/heat. Upserts/removals form one atomic frame; fuel-owner associations are rebuilt after it. Empty camera deltas preserve current residue. full replaces; optional completeCollections:[rubble] reconciles a complete snapshot. A falls tombstone removes only flight; a rubble tombstone removes that residue. Current fallId/rubbleId/landing footprint take priority over originalSourceSurfaceId provenance.

view.sampleWind: optional function supplied by the host; no frozen Ashland wind field applied to Hopkins

rules: Cutaway never changes physical openings or surviving support.
An opening openFraction changes glass/door presentation; intact:false retires the physical record and its shadow.
Physical patch coverage is required for a runtime patch smaller than an artist surface.
Full frames replace state; later frames merge stable-ID changes and tombstones. Reset/backward seek clears prior state.
Fuel amounts are finite prototype units, not a calibrated real-world mass model. Coder owns burn profiles.
Original 1.65 m doors remain identified until the measured passage decision. No actor is resized.

Adjacent burning support polygons may share an overlap envelope. Every active input remains represented and overlap group/source counts are in inspect; no fuel or spread changes. Cutaway hides the same clipped wall height in flame presentation.
Structural attachment support uses declared native source joinery. Mechanical support loss may move the same remaining fuel before its nominal material burn completes. The runtime owns that decision.
